hypothesis: The first close outside a fully observed fixed-UTC session range can overextend and mean-revert over the next few hours, especially when crypto liquidity differs between weekdays and weekends.
research_proxy: BTCUSDT Binance spot official monthly klines
derivation_disclosure: Preregistered after v13 continuation produced 0/288 development passes. V13 development may motivate inversion but cannot validate v14; parameters are the same symmetric grid rather than retuned to v13 winners.

data_contract.input: checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC H1
data_contract.proxy_limitation: Research only until BTCUSDT/BTCUSD Ostium parity passes

execution_contract.trigger: first completed H1 close outside the frozen range; trade in the opposite direction at next H1 open
execution_contract.exit: ATR catastrophe stop or close after 2/4/8 H1 bars
execution_contract.position_policy: one position per candidate; at most one signal per anchored session

stability.representative: graph medoid of largest stable component per categorical group without performance metrics

sqcli_policy: No SQCLI until stable development, validation, OOS and small-account gates pass.
